name: edrisaturay/filament-starter-minimal
description: Minimal Filament v5 starter plugin: essential panel plugins only (Shield-first, extensible registry).

suggest.bezhansalleh/filament-panel-switch: Switch between Filament panels from the topbar.
suggest.bezhansalleh/filament-exceptions: View Laravel exceptions inside a Filament resource.
suggest.bezhansalleh/filament-language-switch: Zero-config language switcher for Filament panels.
suggest.jeffgreco13/filament-breezy: User profile, password reset, and 2FA flows for Filament.
suggest.z3d0x/filament-logger: Activity logger UI for Filament (uses spatie/laravel-activitylog).
suggest.rawand201/filament-connection-badge: Show the active database connection in the Filament topbar.
suggest.tomatophp/filament-media-manager: Full media-manager UI with folders and uploads.
suggest.rupadana/filament-api-service: Generate REST API endpoints from your Filament resources.
suggest.kenepa/resource-lock: Prevent two users from editing the same record simultaneously.
suggest.charrafimed/global-search-modal: Replace the Filament global search with a richer modal.
suggest.pxlrbt/filament-spotlight: Cmd+K spotlight launcher for Filament panels.
suggest.awcodes/filament-quick-create: Topbar quick-create dropdown for Filament resources.
suggest.filament/spatie-laravel-media-library-pl: Filament form components for spatie/laravel-medialibrary (component package — used inside resources, not registered as a panel plugin).
suggest.filament/spatie-laravel-settings-plugin: Settings pages backed by spatie/laravel-settings (component package).
suggest.filament/spatie-laravel-tags-plugin: Filament form components for spatie/laravel-tags (component package).
suggest.riodwanto/filament-ace-editor: Ace code-editor form field for Filament (component package).
suggest.ralphjsmit/laravel-filament-components: Collection of handy Filament form/table components (component package).
suggest.stechstudio/filament-impersonate: Impersonate users — adds Table/Page actions, not a panel plugin (component package).
suggest.owen-it/laravel-auditing: Eloquent auditing trait — wire into your models, not registered as a Filament plugin.
